scope: Sweep allocation failures through whole-operation AC1032 DXF writes containing a structured SUNSTUDY record, then verify rollback, same-codec retry and typed readback.

source.profile: One SUNSTUDY with two date pairs, three hour flags, subset/range selection, date interval, viewport/grid settings and no optional handle references; emitted as AC1032 ASCII and Binary. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Add a focused mode to the whole-operation allocation harness. Warm the writer, calibrate allocations with an existing destination, inject one-shot allocation failures at every measured offset, and verify destination bytes, caller fields, source-handle binding rollback and staging cleanup. Retry on the same codec and require byte-identical output plus typed readback of modeled fields and ordered date/hour arrays.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests -j4: PASS; ASan target build: PASS
validation.directRun: PASS; ASCII 93 and Binary 91 allocation offsets injected; caller/destination/identity rollback, staging cleanup, same-codec retry and typed readback passed.

limitations: Generated transaction evidence for one AC1032 writer profile does not establish independent producer wire semantics or interoperability.
The standalone SUNSTUDY is not joined to its owner dictionary or required graph dependencies, and no native Sun Study behavior is qualified.
No support claim is promoted and no drawing fixture is committed.
nextAction: Continue the P6-G public-writer inventory and select another exact uncovered route or version-specific variant with rollback, same-codec retry and readback.
